posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Shared a wholesome May photo dump featuring family moments with Vicky Kaushal and a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan's tiny hands during Vicky's 38th birthday celebration.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Surprised Toronto fans by screening the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer during his AURA Tour 2026 concert and announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on Sept 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bobby Deol dismissed clash rumours on the Alpha set, praising her professionalism; the YRF spy thriller has been preponed to July 3, 2026.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Shared poolside Sunday vibes from Hyderabad while shooting SS Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu; also confirmed for Krrish 4 alongside Hrithik Roshan.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release (Dec 24) with Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan; also spotted cruising Mumbai in a brand new Cadillac Escalade.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: In advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film; also prepping for the gritty thriller Daayra with director Meghna Gulzar.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: In talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological drama Mahavatar; also working on a period musical with the studio.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh; will use a body double for action sequences in Atlee's Raaka while continuing to film SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 heading to OTT on June 4 after a massive ₹1800 crore worldwide theatrical run; next film Pralay begins shooting in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit passionately defended her against body-shaming trolls who targeted her Cannes 2026 appearance, calling out the double standards in Bollywood.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Launched the Cocktail 2 trailer to massive buzz and shared stunning honeymoon photos from Japan with husband Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Gulshan Devaiah joins the cast of her upcoming Maa Inti Bangaram; she's also producing the film under her banner Tralala Moving Pictures.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Kicked off the shoot for Raaka with director Atlee; also reportedly in talks to collaborate with Lokesh Kanagaraj for a high-octane action film next.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi releasing June 4 with AR Rahman's score; trailer smashed 100M+ views in 24 hours and US advance bookings are tracking strong.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon first glimpse crossed 105M views making it the most-watched Indian teaser; set to reunite with Trivikram for a mythological epic next.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Busy promoting Peddi alongside Ram Charan; praised his dedication and professionalism in a new interview ahead of the June 4 release.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Chand Mera Dil crossed ₹24.30 crore in 10 days; graced the Filmfare cover discussing privilege in Bollywood; viral dance video with dad Chunky Panday.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Opened up about post-pregnancy body shaming in a candid interview; dismissed rumours about discomfort with bold scenes in Yash's upcoming Toxic.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Krrish 4 stuck in a VFX disagreement with YRF over quality standards; meanwhile joined Ryan Gosling's Project Hail Mary for the India theatrical push.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releasing June 5 — David Dhawan's announced final directorial; promoted the film at the IPL final with a surprise appearance.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Released the devotional song Siddha Bhajo as a heartfelt tribute to her late father; Unstoppable Tour heading to Australia and New Zealand in June.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Composed the score for Ram Charan's Peddi releasing June 4; reuniting with Shekhar Kapur for Masoom: The New Generation; named JBL Music Academy 2026 mentor.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jananayagan, believed to be his final film, leaked online sparking outrage; release now targeting June/July after TN elections; piracy condemned by Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan.
